input: N x 4 x 64 x 64 (R,G,B,NIR), median-subtracted reflectance / 0.10

real_sources.note: SEN2MS vessel/non-vessel crops, train products only (crc32(product) % 4 != 0)
hand-adjudicated contacts from 12 of 16 real Sentinel-2 scenes; oversampled so a few hundred real hard negatives are not swamped by 11k mined synthetic chips

held_out_real_scenes.note: Excluded from training entirely; chips hand-adjudicated by the team. Miami (also a shallow turbid bay) stays in training, so Tampa measures generalisation to an unseen turbid bay rather than memorisation. Reproduce with training/eval_verifier.py.

known_weaknesses: Scored only at 10 m (Sentinel-2), not the 4.75 m target GSD.
Shallow turbid water remains the worst case: Tampa Bay precision 0.467 against Puget Sound 0.933.
Trained on 368 adjudicated chips from one sensor and one season; a different sea state or sun angle is untested.
